# Life in the Simulation

> Evidence-aware essays and practical field guides about simulation theory, consciousness, artificial intelligence, attention, privacy and modern digital life.

Canonical site: https://lifeinthesimulation.com/
Editorial policy: https://lifeinthesimulation.com/editorial-policy.html
